verdict.rationale: Bento's Subscribers API supports paginated GET requests (1–1000 per call) filterable by tags, segment, and date ranges, and the CLI can 'search subscribers, import from CSV,' which together allow a founder to script a bulk pull of contact/tag/field data via API or CLI. However, there is no documented one-click or bulk 'export' command, no explicit mention of exporting engagement/event history or the suppression list, and no confirmed open-format (CSV/JSON) full-account export tool. Missing for 10: dedicated export endpoint/CLI command, explicit suppression-list export, engagement-history export, and confirmation of a single self-serve full-account export flow.
